title: WattWise: Smart Electricity Billing
context: Smart meters report consumption every interval. Utilities bill with slab tariffs, sell recharge packs and flag faults.
input: Readings per interval; slab boundaries; recharge pack sizes.

milestones.title: Recharge packs
milestones.requirement: Fewest prepaid packs of 50, 120 and 200 units for an exact top-up (coin change).

milestones.title: Bill divisibility
milestones.requirement: Count periods whose usage is a multiple of k (remainder counting).

milestones.title: Peak demand
milestones.requirement: Highest consumption over any 3 consecutive intervals.

milestones.title: Slab lookup
milestones.requirement: Slab for a cumulative usage (lower bound).

milestones.title: Rolling maximum load
milestones.requirement: Sliding window maximum for transformer sizing.
